AGGREGATE:examples-and-development-conte.reason: Registered examples have individual cards; demonstration models, shared tiers and the dev-only creative tab are documented support, not additional spells.

AGGREGATE:provider-contract-metadata.reason: Common registration declarations, namespace/localization metadata and host contract wiring support individually documented registry objects and consumers.

AGGREGATE:bootstrap-build-and-publisher-.reason: Build, wrapper, repository templates and entrypoint registration wiring establish provenance and initialization without an independent spell or perk.

AGGREGATE:auxiliary-artwork.reason: Unregistered model, texture and pack artwork filenames do not register items, entities or spells; used rendering resources are also mapped to consumers.
